caption_used: Sparsity ratio of SDPA output across layers under the 1e-2 threshold, comparing three gating configurations. The sparsity ratio before gate (blue dashed, avg 0.03) begins at approximately 0.2 and declines steadily to near zero by layer 5, remaining flat thereafter. The sparsity ratio after gate (orange dotted, avg 0.44) starts at 1.0 and decreases sharply, converging with the after-average-gate line near 0.15 by layer 10 before both stabilize. Notably, the after-average-gate configuration (green dash-dot, avg 0.33) consistently maintains higher sparsity than the after-gate line across all layers beyond the initial decline, with the two lines never intersecting after layer 5. The before-gate configuration demonstrates that pre-gating hidden states exhibit minimal sparsity throughout the network.

raw_responses.Bulgarian: DESCRIPTION: The figure is a line chart titled "Sparsity Ratio of SDPA Output, Threshold 1e-2", illustrating the sparsity ratio across layers for three different gating configurations in a neural network. The x-axis, labeled "Layer", ranges from 0 to approximately 22 with linear scaling and integer tick marks at intervals of 5. The y-axis, labeled "Sparsity Ratio", ranges from 0.0 to 1.0 with linear scaling and tick marks at intervals of 0.2. Three distinct lines are plotted: a blue dashed line representing "sparsity ratio before gate, avg 0.03", an orange dotted line for "sparsity ratio after gate, avg 0.44", and a green dash-dot line for "sparsity ratio after average gate, avg 0.33". The blue dashed line begins at approximately 0.2 at layer 0, decreases sharply to near 0.0 by layer 5, and remains flat at near-zero values through layer 22. The orange dotted line starts at 1.0 at layer 0, drops steeply to around 0.5 by layer 5, continues to decline to approximately 0.15 by layer 10, and then fluctuates between 0.15 and 0.4 with small oscillations until layer 22. The green dash-dot line begins at 1.0 at layer 0, decreases to approximately 0.35 by layer 5, continues to decline to around 0.15 by layer 10, and then remains relatively stable with minor fluctuations between 0.1 and 0.15 until layer 22. The green dash-dot line consistently lies above the orange dotted line for all layers beyond layer 5, and the two lines do not intersect after layer 5. The blue dashed line remains below both other lines throughout the entire range.
raw_responses.Chinese: DESCRIPTION: This line chart displays the sparsity ratio of SDPA (Scaled Dot-Product Attention) output across layers, under a threshold of 1e-2, for three different gating configurations. The x-axis represents the layer number, ranging from 0 to 22 with linear spacing and integer tick marks at intervals of 5. The y-axis represents the sparsity ratio, ranging from 0.0 to 1.0 with linear spacing and tick marks at intervals of 0.2. Three data series are plotted: the sparsity ratio before gate (blue dashed line, avg 0.03), which starts at approximately 0.2 at layer 0 and decreases to near 0.0 by layer 5, remaining flat thereafter; the sparsity ratio after gate (orange dotted line, avg 0.44), which begins at 1.0 at layer 0, drops sharply to around 0.45 by layer 5, and then fluctuates between approximately 0.15 and 0.40 from layer 10 to layer 22; and the sparsity ratio after average gate (green dash-dot line, avg 0.33), which starts at 1.0 at layer 0, decreases to about 0.35 by layer 5, and then stabilizes between approximately 0.05 and 0.15 from layer 10 to layer 22. The three lines do not intersect after layer 5, with the green line consistently below the orange line and the blue line remaining near zero throughout.
raw_responses.English: DESCRIPTION: This line plot illustrates the sparsity ratio of SDPA (Scaled Dot-Product Attention) output across different layers of a model, under a threshold of 1e-2, comparing three gating configurations. The x-axis, labeled "Layer," is linear and ranges from 0 to approximately 22, with tick marks at regular intervals of 5. The y-axis, labeled "Sparsity Ratio," is also linear and ranges from 0.0 to 1.0, with tick marks at intervals of 0.2. Three distinct lines are shown: a blue dashed line representing the sparsity ratio before gate (average 0.03), which starts at approximately 0.2 at layer 0 and decreases steadily to near 0.0 by layer 5, remaining flat thereafter; an orange dotted line for the sparsity ratio after gate (average 0.44), which begins at 1.0 and drops sharply, reaching approximately 0.15 by layer 10, then fluctuates slightly around 0.2 to 0.4 in later layers; and a green dash-dot line for the sparsity ratio after average gate (average 0.33), which starts at 1.0, decreases steeply, and stabilizes around 0.1 by layer 10, with minor fluctuations thereafter. The green line remains consistently above the orange line for all layers beyond layer 5, and the blue line remains near zero throughout.
